newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products end mixed, gas oil catches crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products end mixed, gas oil catches crude.

text.p: NWE oil products ended mixed on Friday, traders said.
Gas oil nudged higher as futures played catch-up with crude and diesel premiums rose as tight supplies started to bite.
High sulphur fuel barges traded at $82 and $82.50 but traders believed only some five deals were done. Cargo markets were very quiet, held up by optimism, not reality, traders said.
Gasoline was slightly firmer with a Eurograde barge trading at $198.50 a tonne for delivery up to May 10.
Naphtha was slightly stronger in a quiet market with may swaps talked around the $180/$180.50 level.
